title: Two Engram host tests leak their test-state directory, failing the full gate's temp-cleanup guard
outcome: The full gate's rust-tests stage passes its temp-cleanup guard: the named tests remove their termal-test-state directories and owner files before the run ends, because no AppState clone outlives the test.
acceptance: A full gate run on a commit that contains the fix reports no 'Test temp leftover' lines for recognised_tests_name_the_bound_claim_and_the_other_live_named_claim and a_background_command_still_running_in_its_own_turn_overlaps_that_turns_later_check.
The cause is identified (which owner keeps the state alive) and fixed without weakening the cleanup guard, Arc::get_mut exclusivity or lock bounds.
disposal_reason: Duplicate of w-6bb54cae56aa, which Termal::Fable2 filed for the same C4 FULL 6580d0ce temp-cleanup leak. My notes (the two creating tests, the retained run root, the hypotheses, and Greg's verbatim deferral) are recorded on w-3fe8.
